answer: Hritik Roshan, son of filmmaker Rakesh Roshan, was into the spotlight early in life. qas.question: who is ritik roshan?
answer: Hrithik Roshan ( Hindi: ; born 10 January 1974) is an Indian actor who works in Hindi cinema . He has portrayed a variety of characters and is known for his dancing skills. One of the highest-paid actors in India, he has won many awards , including six Filmfare Awards , of which four were for Best Actor . Starting from 2012, he has appeared in Forbes India 's Celebrity 100 several times based on his income and popularity.
